tabs.html:
Camelion Ni-MH 1.2V 1000mAh AA HR6 Rechargeable Battery – 2 Pack

Power your everyday devices with the Camelion Ni-MH 1000mAh AA HR6 Rechargeable Batteries. Designed for long-lasting performance, these 1.2V AA batteries deliver reliable energy for high-drain devices such as digital cameras, remote controls, toys, wireless mice, and more.


With 1000mAh capacity, they provide consistent power output and are environmentally friendly, reducing waste from disposable batteries. These Ni-MH (Nickel-Metal Hydride) rechargeable batteries can be recharged up to 1000 times, saving money and supporting sustainable energy use.


Each pack includes 2 high-quality AA batteries, ready to deliver dependable performance right out of the box.


Key Features:

  • Rechargeable AA Battery Pack – Includes 2 high-performance Ni-MH AA batteries
  • 1000mAh Capacity – Provides steady and long-lasting power for daily-use devices
  • 1.2V Output – Suitable for all standard AA battery-compatible electronics
  • Eco-Friendly – Reduces environmental waste by replacing disposable batteries
  • Up to 1000 Recharge Cycles – Cost-effective and reusable for years
  • No Memory Effect – Charge anytime without reducing battery life
  • Versatile Use – Ideal for remote controls, cameras, flashlights, toys, and more
  • Reliable Brand – Trusted Camelion quality for consistent performance
